title: Repair SRD equipment import completeness and armor fields
description:
﻿Repair D&D SRD 5.1 equipment import completeness and incorrect armor fields found during the final pack accuracy audit.

Problem:
The committed canonical pack contains only one equipment record, equipment:padded, even though the SRD Equipment chapter contains armor, weapons, adventuring gear, tools, mounts/vehicles, and other equipment tables. The one emitted record is also inaccurate: Padded armor should have stealth disadvantage and weight 8 lb. according to the SRD armor table.

Scope:
- Fix the equipment parser so it imports all intended SRD 5.1 equipment table rows according to the documented parser scope.
- Include armor, shields, weapons, and adventuring/equipment table rows that the current parser is intended to cover.
- Correct Padded armor fields, including stealth disadvantage and weight.
- Preserve deterministic keys and source provenance.
- Regenerate the canonical D&D SRD 5.1 pack after parser fixes.

Acceptance criteria:
- equipment:padded matches the SRD armor table, including stealth disadvantage and weight.
- Armor table rows are imported or explicitly documented as intentionally out of scope.
- Weapons table rows are imported or explicitly documented as intentionally out of scope.
- Adventuring gear/tool/equipment rows are imported or explicitly documented as intentionally out of scope.
- Add exact or reviewed equipment baseline tests that fail if major equipment categories collapse back to a single record.
- npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exits 0.
- npm run audit:rules-pack -- packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1 reports no new suspicious findings.
- npm run check, npm run typecheck, and npm test pass.
- Do not change source vendoring policy.
- Do not introduce Pathfinder work.
close_reason: Rewrote parseEquipment to reconstruct the SRD 5.1 split-column Armor/Weapons tables and row-major Tools table; equipment 1->85 records, equipment:padded corrected (stealth disadvantage + 8 lb.). Gear/containers/mounts documented out of scope. All gates pass; PR #144.
